stage1.impression: A clean, legible straight-on shot of a milk-carton speaker that reads as a flat graphic: the square camera hides every side face, the white body is lit evenly like a printed card, and the chrome earmilk letters look muddy grey. The carton is cut off at the base with no shadow or contact on a dull warm-grey sweep, so it floats without weight; a competent draft, not a homepage hero.

blocking_9: The white back must model instead of printing flat: part:back-panel median 214-220 with p95 <= 232 (now 232.2 / 239.3), and the left margin strip [200,350,262,1120] must fall >= 18 levels from eave to frame bottom (now 10.2, 240.3 -> 230.1, all of it inside PBR Neutral's compressed shoulder above 226).

The cast earmilk letters must read as metal on the lacquer: part:letters-back-* median >= 35 levels below the panel beside them (now 230.1 against 239.1 at [300,360,330,450] and 235.2 at [575,360,610,450]; the word reads only through 1 px shadows at about 203), keeping a sheen lum_range of 30-50 across the word (now 45.2).

The port must read as a tube, not a black disc in a grey washer: its lower inner wall (port-tube in [415,972,485,998]) median 14-38, graded from the lip inward (now 5.8, p95 14.2), with pure black only on the woofer motor and a neutral flange (the top flange, port-tube in [430,880,470,893], is rgb 178/163/152, warmed by the 4500 K port_fill, against a 233/232/232 panel).
The brand red within dE00 2.0 of #C62828 across part:gable-block (now 2.34; the roof slope [230,190,670,335] is 3.08 at rgb 212/43/45 and the fin's lit end [220,116,255,165] 2.82 at 212/39/41).

Both corner rounds must carry a crisp highlight >= 15 levels above the panel beside them (now left [189,450,194,800] p95 245.4 over 238.1, +7; right [705,450,710,800] p95 240.5 over 230.2, +10, a single bright column at x 709).

changes.problem: The white back is exposed into PBR Neutral's compressed shoulder (above 226), so the key's diagonal falloff prints as one flat value and the back reads as a printed card, and the same overexposure lifts the red off spec.
changes.expected: Simulated on this frame by inverting PBR Neutral: part:back-panel median 232.2 -> about 217 (p95 239.3 -> about 231); the left margin strip falls about 18 levels (233 -> 215) instead of 10, the right strip 221 -> 206, so the upper-left to lower-right key falloff becomes visible; bottom right [640,850,697,1120] 223.4 -> about 207, still the brightest surface against a background of about 150 (left) and 135 (bottom right); gable dE00 2.34 -> about 1.4 (roof slope 3.08 -> about 0.6, rgb about 197/36/38); glow behind the fin 189 -> about 175; Facts ink stays <= 16; letters 230 -> about 218 before c2.

changes.problem: The cast earmilk letters, a must-show, are lit by their sheen glint to the panel's own value, so the word is legible only through hairline shadows and reads as white-on-white embossing, not metal.

evidence.measured: part:letters-back-* median 230.1 (p5 187.0, p95 232.2, range 45.2), rgb 236/229/225; panel beside them 239.1 at [300,360,330,450] and 235.2 at [575,360,610,450], a 5-9 level gap. y-profile through the m (x 455-470): panel 237.1, face 231.4, a 1 px shadow at 203.0, panel 235.3. The e and k, partly outside the sheen's footprint, are 209.6 and 217.4. Comparing e9-04a (sheen size 0.28, exposure 0.25: faces 199-201) with this frame (size 0.2254, exposure 0.3183: 230-231), the sheen supplies about two thirds of the face light.

changes.expected: With about half the mirrored lamp, the middle letters fall from 231 to about 185-195 and the e and k to about 150-170, so the word sits 35-50 levels under the 223-231 panel around it (after c1) and reads as satin metal. lum_range stays about 35-50, so the sheen still falls off across the word. Nothing else changes (receivers are the eight letters).

changes.problem: The port's bore is unlit, so the port is a pure-black disc in a grey ring (the frame's hardest contrast, directly under the Facts panel). The 4500 K port_fill, 4.5 cm off the top flange, spends its light warming that flange instead of reaching into the tube.

evidence.measured: Lower inner wall (port-tube in [415,972,485,998]) median 5.8, p95 14.2; woofer-motor median 0.9, 83% crushed; port box 25% crushed; x-profile at y 945-965 steps 128.3 -> 10.7 -> 0 within one 5 px bin at the left lip. Top flange (port-tube in [430,880,470,893]) 164.6, rgb 178/163/152 (R-B 26) against the 233/232/232 panel; bottom flange [430,1015,470,1029] 111.0. The engine's proofs: 0.02 W -> 0.4, 0.08 -> 2.1, 0.2 -> 4.6 in the bore.

changes.expected: From 13.5 cm out and 15 cm above the port axis (centre about z 0.371), the lamp shines into the mouth at about 45 degrees instead of grazing the top flange from 4.5 cm. The lower inner wall reads about 30-40 at the lip, fading to about 15-20 where the top lip's shadow crosses it near y 977, then black on the woofer motor (<= 5). Bore box median 5.8 -> 18-30. The flange turns neutral and more even: top about 115-135 (now 164.6, R-B 26), bottom about 110-120 (now 111). Panel, letters and motor unchanged (receivers port-tube).

changes.problem: The right corner round (the shadow-side silhouette) carries only a 1 px glint, so the edge reads as a cut-out rather than a lacquered 6 mm round, and c1 will weaken it further.

evidence.measured: p95 240.5, median 231.7 against 230.2 just inside [684,450,702,800]; x-profile at y 600-640 (x 703-710): 229.2, 226.5, 226.7, 230.7, 232.6, 231.5, 239.7, 232.9, a darker turn then one bright column at x 709. Simulated after c1: p95 234.5 against a 215.0 panel.

changes.expected: The outer 3-5 px of the right round (x 706-710) brighten into a rim: p95 234.5 (after c1) -> about 242-245 and median 217.7 -> about 222-230, 25-30 levels above the panel beside it (about 215). The strip sits behind the back's plane, so it reaches only the round and the back face does not change.

changes.problem: The left corner round's highlight is only 7 levels over the key-lit panel beside it (both in the shoulder), so the lit edge reads as a soft brighter band rather than a gloss round.
changes.expected: The left round's 5 px band (x 189-193) rises from p95 242.4 (after c1) to about 247-249, 18-20 levels above the panel beside it (about 229), so both silhouette edges read as gloss rounds, the key side the brighter. As with c4, the back face does not change.

out_of_scope.request: Turn the carton a few degrees, or move the camera off-axis, so a sliver of a side face shows.
out_of_scope.why: It would make the carton read as a box instead of a card, the largest remaining gap to a 9. But the purpose fixes a straight-on, level view of the Facts panel, and a turn would converge its rules.

out_of_scope.request: Pull back to show the plinth, SHAKE WELL, the amp plate and a contact shadow on the floor.
out_of_scope.why: The carton is cut at about z 0.25 m with no grounding, so it floats. But the purpose frames the Facts panel with the gable above, and fitting the full 1.055 m would shrink the Facts type by about a quarter.

out_of_scope.request: Deepen the 3 mm shadow line under the gable.
out_of_scope.why: The eave steps from red 63.8 to white 232.0 through a soft 4 px ramp (130.0, 182.5, 202.8, 218.1 at y 344-347) with no dark hairline, so the gable and body barely separate. The line's depth is spec geometry.

out_of_scope.request: Give the port flange a lighter or satin finish.
out_of_scope.why: It reads as a flat grey ring (bottom 111.0, sides 114-129). The port tube's material is the product's own, so c3 changes only how its bore and flange are lit.
